selection_rule.predeclared_rotation: After five settled Blind cases in consumer electrical, logistics, resource deep processing, industrial equipment and property management, select the next unrepresented large-process-industry company from the fixed chemistry/manufacturing slot.
selection_inputs: curriculum register company-cluster and industry coverage through the fifth settled Blind
company identity and sector classification only
prohibited_selection_inputs: FY2024 annual-report content or any other post-cutoff result
price, return, market performance, analyst commentary or derived company report
selection_rule.reason_not_result_selected: CN:600309 fills the next fixed sector slot and is outside every settled Blind company cluster and industry. The choice is recorded before any FY2024 source may be opened.

preoutcome_research_problem.state_and_constraint: Process-industry capacity additions, feedstock/product spreads and customer demand must be separated from reported sales growth.
preoutcome_research_problem.management_choice_or_no_action: Assess capacity, integration, product-mix and capital-spending decisions without pre-judging their outcome.
preoutcome_research_problem.customer_or_operating_link: Demand absorption, utilization, product price/cost spread and customer collection quality must be observed before output growth receives economic credit.
preoutcome_research_problem.cash_or_capital_link: Operating cash, working capital and maintenance/growth capital must be separated before treating reported profit or capacity deployment as owner cash or capital return.

role_and_source_firewall.preoutcome_source_allowed: issuer official FY2023 annual report and cutoff-before issuer materials only
role_and_source_firewall.outcome_source_sealed: issuer official FY2024 annual report; no content may be opened until a fresh forecaster, result-free independent preoutcome review and single-source custody authorization are frozen
